title: How To Start A YouTube Automation Business in 10 Minutes
summary: How-to for starting a faceless YouTube channel with free AI tools; promises endless potential with consistency while warning success takes time.

assertions.quote: I have a list of six free tools that are going to allow you to start creating YouTube videos automatically
most people fail when it comes to this type of business for three reasons the first is from burnout
YouTube cares about four things the first is audience retention the second is Click through rate then watch time and then finally session time
each Niche has different cpms and RPMs
if you're able to be consistent and avoid burnout the potential is endless and it's one of the best side hustles out there right now

verdicts.note: In a random sample of YouTube the median video had 35 views and 86.93% had under a thousand, while the 3.67% of videos above 10,000 views took 93.61% of all views: the typical uploader is nowhere near a thousand dollars a day, though the sample does not single out consistent uploaders or automation channels.
